export: NDOT Traffic Safety Engineering crash data (NCATSDW), as delivered on a Crash Data Request (Survey123) or public-records request
spec: Nevada TRCC Data Dictionary, Jan 2021, section 2.1 'Crash Data Columns', pp. 4-6 (https://zerofatalitiesnv.com/app/uploads/2021/04/2021-01-NV-TRCC-Data-Dictionary.pdf, saved ~/.hermes/state-manuals/nv/)
layout_seen_live: The same columns (shapefile-truncated to 10 chars) are published by the City of Las Vegas, https://services1.arcgis.com/F1v0ufATbBQScMtY/arcgis/rest/services/Traffic_Crashes/FeatureServer/0 (2015-2020), checked 2026-11-08
unit: one row per crash; vehicle 1 and 2 fields are flattened onto the crash row (V1_*, V2_*); no person table in the documented layout

map.collision_id: Accident Rec Num (CLV: Accident_R, e.g. '3044968.0': strip the '.0')
map.primary_road: Primary Street. NDOT writes routes run together with a direction: IR15N -> I-15, US95S -> US 95, SR159 -> NV 159, CC215S -> CC 215. 'X TO Y INTnn' is a ramp (CLV 2020: 112 rows 'IR15N TO SR589 INT40')
map.sec_direction: Dir (N/S/E/W; 'AT INT' = at the intersection, distance 0)
map.milepost: Mile Marker, Adj. Mile Marker (in the dictionary; not in the CLV copy)
map.severity: Crash Severity + Injury Type: FATAL CRASH/FATAL ACCIDENT -> K; INJURY CRASH/INJURY ACCIDENT with Injury Type A/B/C -> A/B/C; injury with Injury Type U/N/blank -> U; PROPERTY DAMAGE ONLY -> O. Dictionary 2.1.1 p.7 lists K, A, B, C, O, U (unknown), N (not reported)
map.collision_type: Crash Type (Angle, Rear-End, Head-On, Non-Collision, Sideswipe, Backing ...)
map.is_freeway: derived: Primary Street starts IR, or is CC215 / a ramp ('INTnn')
map.lat_lon: NOT in the documented column list. NDOT's own open layer (gis.dot.nv.gov TrafficSafety/CrashData_OpenData_2019_2023, now stopped) and consultants' copies of NDOT data are point layers, so the request may come with X/Y: ask for it. Without it every crash is placed from Primary/Secondary/Distance/Dir, the California way
